title: Grateful Dead Live at Performing Arts Center on 1972-10-23
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi Dragon) -> Dat -> CD; CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC (3 Discs Audio / 2 Discs FLAC)
source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-124/BASF Normal Bias 120 Min Tapes)

ai_review.summary: Warm audience cassette captures a high‑energy 1972 show with standout performances of Stella Blue, Deal and an epic Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience tape that, despite some cloudiness and the need for careful editing between sources, delivers surprising depth and warmth. The concert itself is described as a high‑energy two‑hour first set featuring gorgeous renditions of Stella Blue, a sick Deal, and a truly epic Dark Star, making it a fan favorite.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the recording quality (warm, clear enough), yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience cassette with some cloudy sound and tape‑editing between sources, but overall warm, clear depth; praised for being surprisingly crisp for an audience recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑hour first set with high energy and smooth transitions, highlighted by strong performances of the noted songs.
